s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of respiratory distress with a subcutaneous mass in the cervical region
salient_findings: Subcutaneous mass in the ventral cervical region
Mild leukocytosis with neutrophilia and lymphopenia
key_facts: 1-week history of dyspnea and inspiratory noise
Esophageal obstruction was suspected but not confirmed
Subcutaneous mass is 10 × 8 × 3-cm, partially firm and fluctuant, and mildly warm
Normal vital signs and good body condition
No dysphagia, other masses, or lymphadenopathy detected
Mild leukocytosis with neutrophilia and lymphopenia
Eosinophils are decreased
Hematocrit is 39.8%
MCV is mildly increased, and MCHC is mildly decreased
Flexible endoscopy of the esophagus and trachea showed no abnormalities
Cervical ultrasonography showed a well-demarcated, heterogeneously echogenic, encapsulated mass

shortlist.label: Abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Subcutaneous mass is partially firm and fluctuant, and mildly warm, with mild leukocytosis and neutrophilia

shortlist.label: Thyroid adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subcutaneous mass in the cervical region, with ultrasonography showing a well-demarcated, heterogeneously echogenic, encapsulated mass

shortlist.label: Thyroglossal duct cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Subcutaneous mass in the cervical region, with ultrasonography showing a well-demarcated, encapsulated mass

shortlist.label: Granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Subcutaneous mass is partially firm and fluctuant, with mild leukocytosis and neutrophilia, and ultrasonography showing a heterogeneously echogenic mass

raw.rationale: The presence of a subcutaneous mass that is partially firm and fluctuant, mildly warm, and painful, along with mild leukocytosis with neutrophilia, suggests an infectious or inflammatory process, which is most consistent with an abscess.

rejected.label: Thyroid adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The mass is described as fluctuant and mildly warm, which is not typical for a thyroid adenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Thyroglossal duct cyst
rejected.why: While possible, the presence of mild warmth and pain is less typical for a cystic structure like a thyroglossal duct cyst

rejected.label: Branchial cleft cyst
rejected.why: These are typically congenital and not associated with the acute onset of symptoms or signs of infection

rejected.label: Granuloma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and laboratory findings are more suggestive of an acute infectious process rather than a granulomatous reaction
